_comment: Smoke config: identical code path, bounded work. Target ~20 min. The DSE screen is deliberately narrowed to three knobs on one cell - a smoke run proves the pipeline, it does not produce a result. Use config/suscom_ten_mixes.json for the real sweep.

traces.clock_hz_note: Ignored unless the Sim_seconds cross-check fails. The first trace column is a gem5 tick (1 ps); prep_trace derives and verifies the time base from the trace header. See docs/DRY_RUN.md section 1.

experiment._array_note: 16 MB, 12 NVM + 4 SRAM ways, 64 B lines - the configuration shipped in HyCSim config.json by the tool authors, which is the configuration these traces were exported under.
experiment._champsim_note: 16 traces chosen for write intensity and suite coverage, not convenience. SPEC CPU2017 matches the manuscript; PARSEC, GAP and XSBench are the suites the audit says are missing; STREAM is the write-saturated bound. The 200+ CRC2 and Pythia traces are omitted deliberately - CRC2 is SPEC CPU2006 and duplicates the HyCSim mixes, and Pythia is a simulator checkout, not traces.
